metadata.question: Does forest cover decrease in the area near Banamepe along the Digul River between November 2002 and November 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to find forest cover change between Nov 2002 and Nov 2019 - Location: Banamepe along the Digul River (Papua, Indonesia) - Data: MODIS Vegetation Continuous Fields (VCF) would be good for forest cover, or Landsat for NDVI analysis - Time: November 2002 vs November 2019 2. Masking strategy: - For forest cover analysis, cloud masking is important - Using MODIS VCF would avoid cloud issues - Using Landsat would require cloud masking 3. Logic: - Compare forest cover % between the two time periods - If forest cover in 2019 < forest cover in 2002 by meaningful amount → A (Yes) - Else → B (No) - Need to check for empty collections and valid pixels I'll use MODIS Vegetation Continuous Fields (VCF) which provides tree cover percentage directly, avoiding the need for complex classification. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const banamepePoint = ee.Geometry.Point([140.3, -6.2]); // Approximate location near Banamepe along Digul River const region = banamepePoint.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around the point // Time periods for comparison (November of each year) const startDate1 = '2002-11-01'; const endDate1 = '2002-11-30'; const startDate2 = '2019-11-01'; const endDate2 = '2019-11-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Vegetation Continuous Fields (Tree Cover %) const modisVCF = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD44B'); const forest2002 = modisVCF .filterDate(startDate1, endDate1) .filterBounds(region) .select('Percent_Tree_Cover'); const forest2019 = modisVCF .filterDate(startDate2, endDate2) .filterBounds(region) .select('Percent_Tree_Cover'); // Check collection sizes const count2002 = forest2002.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = forest2019.size().getInfo(); print(`2002 Images: ${count2002}, 2019 Images: ${count2019}`); if (count2002 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Get mean images for each period const img2002 = forest2002.mean(); const img2019 = forest2019.mean(); // 3. Processing - Calculate forest cover statistics const stats2002 = img2002.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2019 = img2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cover2002 = stats2002.get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo(); const cover2019 = stats2019.get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount2002 = img2002.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo(); const pixelCount2019 = img2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo(); print(`2002 Forest Cover: ${cover2002?.toFixed(1)}%, Pixels: ${pixelCount2002}`); print(`2019 Forest Cover: ${cover2019?.toFixed(1)}%, Pixels: ${pixelCount2019}`); if (pixelCount2002 === 0 || pixelCount2019 === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (cover2002 === null || cover2019 === null || isNaN(cover2002) || isNaN(cover2019) || cover2002 < 0 || cover2002 > 100 || cover2019 < 0 || cover2019 > 100) { print("C3"); return; } const change = cover2019 - cover2002; print(`Forest Change: ${change.toFixed(1)}%`); // If forest cover decreased by more than 1% (meaningful change) if (change < -1) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
